Overview

Victoria (Gozo) is a city in Gozo District with a population of 7,000. The charming capital of Gozo island, a peaceful hilltop town with a medieval citadel, Baroque cathedral, and a relaxed Mediterranean island atmosphere. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 300 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
